recipes.title: Ham & Cheese Stuffed Eggplant with Herb Crumb
steps: Score
Halve the eggplant lengthwise and make several deep lengthwise cuts in each half (not all the way through).
Fill the slits
Slice the ham and cheese and tuck them into the slits.
Herb crumb
Finely chop the basil and garlic and mix with the breadcrumbs and half the olive oil; season with salt and pepper.
Top
Spread the crumb over both halves, drizzle with the remaining oil and scatter with parmesan.
Bake
Bake at 180°C (350°F) convection for about 30 minutes until tender and golden.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's (Riquísimo) recipe card; macros are estimated and on the rich side because of the olive oil. Use half the oil for a lighter version.

recipes.title: Eggplant Roll with Ground Beef, Ham & Cheese
steps: Fry the eggplant
Cut the eggplants lengthwise into 1 cm slices and fry (or grill) on both sides until golden. Lay them overlapping on baking paper to form a base and let cool.
Meat mixture
Mix the ground beef with the eggs, parsley, breadcrumbs, diced bread and grated parmesan; season with salt and pepper and mix by hand until even.
Layer
Spread the meat over the eggplant, leaving about 8 cm free at the top edge. Cover with a layer of ham, then the cheese slices.
Roll
Using the baking paper, roll everything up tightly, pressing so nothing escapes.
Bake
Bake at 180°C (350°F) convection for 15 minutes (until the meat is cooked through), then slice.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's recipe card (salt and pepper reduced from 1 tbsp each to 1 tsp). Macros are estimated per slice (6).

recipes.title: Eggplant Bolognese Volcanoes with Béchamel
steps: Hollow the eggplants
Trim a little off both ends. Stand each eggplant upright, cut around the inside leaving a 1 cm wall, and scoop out the flesh. Brush the insides with olive oil.
Bolognese

Brown the beef in olive oil over high heat, add the onion and garlic and keep frying. Season with salt, pepper, oregano and paprika, then add the tomatoes, tomato paste, spices and a splash of red wine if using. Simmer about 15 minutes.
Béchamel
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and cook briefly until thick. Off the heat, stir in the cheese, beaten eggs and salt.
Fill
Stand the eggplants on a baking tray, fill with bolognese and top each with a spoonful of béchamel.
Bake
Bake at 170°C (340°F) convection for about 20 minutes until golden.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's recipe card; macros are estimated per stuffed eggplant. Any leftover bolognese freezes well.
